purpose: Continue the zero-network historical engine with one finite estimator that is not a tree, neural network, random Fourier kernel, refreshed linear fit, target classification or feature subset search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_alpha158_session_binary_random_hyperplane_hash_regression
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Every Alpha158 coordinate first becomes an above/below/equal-to-session-median state. Eight fixed return-blind Rademacher hyperplanes map the complete state vector to one of 256 cells, and the only fitted value is the session-equal continuous return-percentile mean inside each occupied cell. This is a fixed oblique locality partition, not supervised tree splitting, joint representation learning or smooth kernel regression.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: random_hash_bit_table_seed_threshold_or_smoothing_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Searching bit count, table count, seed, bit threshold, minimum bucket support or shrinkage after Campaign286-288 would create avoidable multiplicity. Campaign289 permits exactly one eight-bit table, seed 289, strict-positive bits, no support threshold and no smoothing.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign288_rff_dimension_bandwidth_penalty_or_rank_map_repair
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign288 is immutable and terminal. Its ordinal RBF random Fourier map, seed, dimension, bandwidth and ridge output cannot be tuned or stacked into Campaign289.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_knn_kernel_svr_gaussian_process_or_anchor_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Exact or approximate neighbor count, metric, support vectors, anchors and kernel regularization introduce a broad locality search, and exact kernel/SVR/Gaussian-process variants were already rejected in Campaign288.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_naive_bayes_forward_up_or_return_bin_classification
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign133 already rejected changing the frozen continuous cross-sectional return-percentile target into a direction or probability-calibration problem. Campaign289 retains the continuous target exactly.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_linear_pairwise_polynomial_or_subset_refit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102/122/132/161 close refreshed signed-linear, sparse, pairwise-interaction and subset searches after exposure; changing the raw library does not erase those terminal model-search decisions.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha360_new_feature_snapshot_on_current_writable_volume
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The authorized system volume has about 8 GiB free, insufficient comfortable headroom for another dense five-year snapshot. This is an infrastructure deferral, not a scientific rejection.

selected_family.feature_library: all 158 Campaign286 Alpha158 features in frozen order
selected_family.input_state: For each signal session and feature among all model-support eligible names: +1 strictly above the finite median, -1 strictly below it, 0 for exact equality or nonfinite input.
selected_family.partition: NumPy default_rng(289) Rademacher matrix of shape 158 by 8; bit j is one exactly when the state-vector dot hyperplane j is strictly positive; the eight bits form an integer cell in [0,255].
selected_family.output_model: Session-equal weighted mean of the unchanged continuous training return percentile in each occupied cell; unseen validation cells receive the session-equal global training mean.
selected_family.training_session_balance: Deterministically select exactly 96 names per contained training session before reading training returns; finite sampled targets receive equal total loss mass per retained session.
